activity_summary: At the stair Mistress Ansell gave you one candle and said she would not light a second. You said you would sit and not walk. You did not say the play was finished. Alse left Gib where he was. Supper, if you take it, is threepence. You promised no errand for next week.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the candle, and refused to say it was finished.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Issued one candle, and did not come up to inspect the page.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Left the cat, and did not sand a new leaf.

facets.activity: Took one candle and went up to sit

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will not say it is finished.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: There is one candle on the stair-table.
